career_risk_cards.fact: Occupational risk mainly comes from recorded lessons and AI courseware. Standard content is moving online, while platform commissions and customer acquisition costs rise. People are still needed for face-to-face guided practice, interaction and motivation, and local communities.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent the courseware becomes, teachers still use their voices, hands, and empathy to engage learners, encourage practice, and retain students. People cannot be removed entirely from supportive instruction.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「线上化 + 平台」——标准内容被录播吃，会带练能留人的老师反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位风险主要来自录播与 AI 课件——标准内容被线上化，且平台抽成与获客成本上升；但面对面带练、互动激励与本地社群仍要人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管课件多聪明，怎么把人带起来、怎么哄着练、怎么留住学员，最后还是老师的嘴去讲、手去纠、心去暖——陪伴这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not replacement but quantification. Systems absorb standardized laboratory testing, while people who can design studies and weigh tradeoffs become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk in this occupation is not replacement but quantification. Remote sensing and data modeling accelerate routine analysis, but sampling design, field judgment, and balancing solutions still require people. Researchers also face pressure from handling both research and fieldwork.
risks: Remote sensing and modeling replace tasks

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent models become, scientists still decide how to collect soil, balance solutions, and communicate with farmers. People cannot be fully removed from work with the land.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是被替代，而是「量化」——标准化验被系统吃，会设计、能权衡的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不在被替代，而在「量化」——遥感与数据建模把常规分析提速，但取样设计、田间判断与方案权衡仍要人；同时科研与田间双线压力大。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管模型多聪明，土怎么取、方案怎么权衡、农民怎么沟通，最后还是科学家去想、去下田、去谈——土地这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is safety responsibility combined with automation. Loading errors and leaks have severe consequences, while systems continue to consume routine operations.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is safety responsibility combined with automation. Incorrect loading, leaks, and spills have severe consequences, while automated loading and load-planning systems consume many routine operations and shrink pure operating roles. Human value is shifting toward safety supervision and exception handling.
risks: Heavy safety accountability with severe consequences for incidents
Exposure to flammable and explosive materials

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, loaders still have to see when a hose is not sealed and decide whether an alarm requires shutdown. Their eyes inspect, their hands stop the equipment, and they bear the responsibility. People cannot be fully removed from loading and unloading.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险是「安全责任 + 自动化」——装载错漏后果严重，常规操作还被系统吃。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「安全责任 + 自动化替代」——装错、泄漏、溢油后果严重；同时自动装车与配载系统吃掉大量常规操作，纯操作岗在缩。人价值转向安全监督与异常处理。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，那根管没封好、报警该不该停，最后还是装载工的眼去看、手去停、心去扛——装卸这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.路径: Outsourced pure data and drafting role

career_risk_cards.callout: The risk in this field truly comes from AI, but only for pure drafters. Move toward policy research, spatial governance, and stakeholder coordination. AI can complete the technical tasks and allow planners to focus on irreplaceable judgment and decision-making.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to the role is AI and digitization. Automated GIS mapping, proposal generation, and metric calculation are replacing substantial technical work, shrinking roles for pure drafters and metric analysts. Planners who interpret policy, coordinate stakeholder interests, and accept responsibility for proposals are becoming scarcer.
risks: AI mapping and calculations replace drafting roles
Repeated proposal revisions create heavy workloads
Industry cycles are affected by land and real estate markets
Pure technical roles lose value as hybrid requirements rise

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can create an attractive proposal drawing in ten minutes, but planners must decide who the land should serve and whether residents have been heard. Their pens shape not just drawings but the future lives of tens of thousands of people, and machines cannot draw that responsibility.

responsibilities: Collect and analyze urban development data

career_path_block.路径: 主任规划师/部门负责人

career_risk_cards.callout: 这行的风险确实在 AI——但只针对「画图匠」。往政策研究、空间治理和多方协调上走，AI 帮你把技术活做完，规划师反而更专注于不可替代的判断与决策。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险正是 AI 与数字化：GIS 自动制图、方案生成、指标测算正在替代大量技术活，纯「画图员」和「算指标」的岗位在收缩；会解读政策、能协调多方利益、敢对方案负责的规划师，反而更稀缺。
risks: AI 制图与测算替代画图岗
方案反复修改，工作强度大
行业周期受土地与地产影响
纯技术岗贬值，复合要求提高

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能十分钟生成一版漂亮的方案图，但「这块地该留给谁、居民有没有被听见」——规划师手里的笔，画的不只是图纸，是几万人未来的生活；这份责任，机器画不出来。

responsibilities: 收集分析城市发展数据

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but channels plus inventory: the products you bet on could end up sitting unsold in a warehouse.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to this occupation is not AI but channel disruption plus inventory risk: e-commerce and livestreaming are reshaping product-selection logic, while a bad product bet or excess inventory directly erodes profit.
risks: E-commerce livestreaming is reshaping product-selection logic
Bad product bets and excess inventory erode profit
Algorithms are reducing replenishment data roles
Channels change quickly, making experience obsolete

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how accurate forecasts become, people still have to bet on what will take off, decide whom to negotiate with, and determine how to build the assortment. Machines will not make the final call on product-selection intuition.

responsibilities: Develop product selections and replenishment plans

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「渠道 + 库存」——你押的款，可能变成仓库里的积压。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「渠道变迁 + 库存风险」——电商和直播重构选品逻辑，押错款或库存积压直接吃掉利润。
risks: 电商直播重构选品逻辑
押错款库存积压吃利润
补货数据岗被算法压缩
渠道变迁快，经验易过时

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管预测多准，什么会火、跟谁谈、怎么搭品类，最后还得人押、人谈——选品的直觉，机器不敢下定论。
